Kaiwen Li received the B.S., M.S. degrees from Na-
tional University of Defense Technology (NUDT),
Changsha, China, in 2016 and 2018.
He is a student with the College of Systems
Engineering, NUDT. His research interests include
prediction technique, multiobjective optimization,
reinforcement learning, data mining, and optimiza-
tion methods on Energy Internet.
Rui Wang received the B.S. degree from National

Engineering, NUDT. His research interests include
evolutionary computation, multiobjective optimiza-
tion, machine learning, and various applications us-
ing evolutionary algorithms.
Tao Zhang received the B.S., M.S., Ph.D. degrees
from National University of Defense Technology

Internet network.
